title: Avoid group column aggregate name display allocation
description: Replace simple_group_by_column_aggregate_projection dispatch via func.name.to_string().to_uppercase() with direct ObjectNamePart matching.

criteria: Group-by column aggregate projection detection no longer builds uppercase display names
COUNT star, COUNT column, and COUNT DISTINCT behavior remains unchanged
SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, STRING_AGG, and GROUP_CONCAT behavior remains unchanged
Qualified names remain rejected by the simple aggregate check

notes: The planner now maps function names to a small base-kind enum through direct ObjectNamePart comparisons.
COUNT still applies the existing DISTINCT, wildcard, and column branches after name classification.
Value aggregates still reject DISTINCT and require a single column argument.
